summary: Brought #268 (the single duel/UI integration candidate, superseding #220 and #248) up to date with main by merge, not rebase. Core conflicts resolved in main's favour: the split duel resolution with paused Focus Effect choices (#425), To First Blood negation (#436), Shigeyuki refusal, main's own-unbowed-personality, battle Declaration Segment phases (#359) and the hand-size decrease; #268's retained DuelRecord rebuilt on top via a ResultDraft on PendingDuel. Mid-duel decisions other than duel stages now reach main's handlers. Client keeps #268 presentation with main's Gold payment panel and phases. Separate rules commits: Suspicions only on its owner's turns and a face-up Event resolves in the Events Phase (rules lead ruling recorded in docs/decisions/2026-09-22-suspicions-owner-events-phase.md); duel results use effective province strength; concession offered mid-duel. Artwork pinned to catalogue-art-pr268-20260922-r1 (3,048 scans).

Each rules fix has a regression shown failing without it. Godot client build/import and native visual/input checks not run locally (no pinned Godot here); CI macOS/Windows to confirm.
